Metadata.title: Tallami Coaching · Competitive Fortnite coaching
Metadata.description: Competitive Fortnite coaching with Tallami, the coach behind {count} FNCS titles. VOD reviews, game plans and Temporada Pro.

Hero.imageAlt: Tallami smiling with headphones on a tournament stage
Hero.title: Train with the coach behind {count} FNCS titles
Hero.lede: I review your games like a final: where you rotated late, which fight you shouldn't have taken, and what to do differently next time. Competitive Fortnite coaching from Argentina for all of Latin America.

Results.title: Results as a coach
Results.intro: Results from players I coached. They authorized showing their name and result.

Reviews.title: Reviews
Reviews.lede: Tweets from my players with their placement and what they won. Tap any one to see it on X.

Services.title: Services and prices
Services.payments: Prices in US dollars. You pay with Mercado Pago, Pix, PayPal or crypto, depending on your country.
Services.minors: Under 18? You can still train: a responsible adult makes the payment.
Services.tip: First time? Start with a 3-game VOD review.

vodRecorded.name: 3-game VOD review
vodRecorded.description: Send me the replay codes for 3 games and I'll send back the video analysis within 72 hours.

tournamentReview.name: Full tournament VOD review
tournamentReview.description: Send me the replay codes for the whole tournament and I'll send back the full video analysis within 96 hours.

vodLive.name: Live VOD review
vodLive.description: We watch your game together for 60 minutes and I correct you in the moment.

gamePlan.name: Custom game plan
gamePlan.description: A plan built around how you play and your upcoming tournaments.

pro.name: Temporada Pro
pro.unit: per team, for the whole season
pro.description: Coaching for your duo or trio for the whole season. Entry is by application.

choose.title: You choose the service
choose.body: Based on what you need to improve, solo or with your duo or trio.

pay.title: You pay
pay.body: With the payment method from your country. Your confirmation arrives by email.

schedule.title: You schedule
schedule.body: You pick a day and time with the link you receive, and you get your role on Discord.

train.title: You train
train.body: Your session or delivery is saved in your portal.

minors.question: Can I train if I'm under 18?
minors.answer: Yes. A responsible adult makes the payment, and the session is with you.

payment.question: How do I pay from my country?
payment.answer: Prices are in US dollars. In Argentina you pay with Mercado Pago, in Brazil with Pix, and in the rest of Latin America with local payment methods. From other countries, with PayPal. You can also pay with crypto.

schedule.question: How do I schedule the session?
schedule.answer: After payment, you get an email with a link to pick a day and time. You also get your role on Discord.

pro.question: How do I join Temporada Pro?
pro.answer: You send in an application. If you're accepted, it's {price} per team for the whole season.
